finlytic.example.subject: SOC 2 Type II evidence at Finlytic
finlytic.example.body:
Hi Rhea,

Finlytic's enterprise customers now ask for SOC 2 Type II reports before signing, and your audit readiness programme is already running. At 120 people, evidence collection usually lands on the security team on top of their day job.

Would a 20-minute call on how teams cut that effort be useful?

Piyush

cartwheel.example.subject: ISO 27001 as a renewal condition at Cartwheel
cartwheel.example.body:
Hi Arjun,

I saw that retail customers have made ISO 27001 part of procurement at Cartwheel, and that you want to get certified quickly. With a 45-person team and no security hire in your open roles, that can fall on engineering.

Open to a short call on getting certified without building a compliance team?

Piyush

zenstack.example.subject: GDPR and SOC 2 evidence for Zenstack's buyers
zenstack.example.body:
Hi Kavita,

Zenstack's buyers are asking for GDPR and SOC 2 evidence while audit prep is still manual and slow. That is usually where enterprise deals slip.

Worth 20 minutes to see how automation shortens that cycle?

Piyush
